summary: @or-sdk/users preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling 727KB file `math_init.js`. Both the dropper (`setup.mjs`) and the payload (`math_init.js`) are obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (rotated const-array + shift-based string decoder `WV8StW`; `@bun-cjs` header; filesystem-mode and network-shaped tokens inside the opaque blob). The package advertises itself as a Users CRUD SDK, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated bundle under it. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled code — the contents of `math_init.js`, which cannot be inspected without execution — to run on the installer's machine via the downloaded Bun interpreter, bypassing Node-oriented scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
